description: WA Cultural Infrastructure Map is an interactive resource (dashboard, viewer or map) listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by WA Department of Local Government, Sport and Cultural Industries. The WA Cultural Infrastructure Map identifies existing cultural and creative spaces across Western Australia. It has ben developed by the WA Department of Local Government, Sport and Cultural Industries. The spaces include theatres, art centres, dance centres, music venues, libraries and broadcasting studios. The map allows users to zoom to Local Government Areas (LGAs) and also filter by facility type. Coverage is Australia; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as not stated, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-08-15. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is not stated in the catalogue entry (source page not read). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
